author: /root/izzet
review_findings: Read all three authored files and all original pinned test bodies at exact Git refs. SHA256 and Git blob SHA1 match for all eight source bindings.

The sole checkout patch adds Base64 printing after the existing unchanged hash update. It is reversible byte-for-byte; the three record call sites, literal seed, deck, golden and original assertions remain unchanged.

Each selected class maps to one existing module through the fetched justfile and scripts/test-class route. Each invocation puts --rerun after that single task and uses the prescribed gradle-locked semaphore with one slot per isolated runner.

The accepted source runs only its existing baseline case; the candidate runs eight existing cases across four classes. Dalkovan leaf case names also agree with retained raw XML from another qualified shared source; this is a naming check, not transfer of acceptance.

Exact source, tree, initial clean checkout and content pins are verified before instrumentation. Existing XML is rejected before stages; fresh executor evidence, exact case inventory and skip/failure counts are collected.
Each original failing test retains its failing exit. Later declared classes still run; raw logs and XML are copied and artifact upload uses always() with if-no-files-found:error.

Workflow triggers only on the named new branch with the declared control paths. No workflow_dispatch or schedule; run_attempt greater than one is excluded. Subsequent pushes affecting these paths would be separate executions and require prior inspection; this review authorizes the one declared push only.
The workflow reads no official seed vector and performs no experiment admission. It creates no scientific allocation or matchup conclusion.
limitations: Source review only: no Kotlin build or fixture was executed locally.
The resulting hashes and complete original failures must be independently audited; no golden update or receiving acceptance is conferred.
Agent source review is not a GitHub approval or independent gameplay admission.
